_comment: Provider/model fingerprints this repository has seen and accepted.
Read by scripts/check-fingerprint.mjs against the fingerprints persisted in run
bundles under .promptnexus/runs/. A provider reporting a fingerprint that is not
listed here fails the build and names the baseline suite to re-run.
The watch is EMPTY and that is currently correct: no run in this repository has
ever reached a provider, so nothing has been observed and nothing can be pinned.
check:fingerprint reports 'not armed' rather than 'OK' while that is true, because
a guard with zero coverage that prints OK is worse than no guard.
Pin the first real observation with `node scripts/check-fingerprint.mjs --write`,
then treat every later change as what it is: a regression you did not introduce.
Accepting a new fingerprint means re-running the named baseline suite and comparing,
